title: “Green” carbon dots from coffee waste for adsorption of xenobiotic and trace heavy metals in both aquatic and physiological media
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, 12,4395-4407
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00345H, Paper
Natalia Krisanova, Konstantin Paliienko, Natalia Pozdnyakova, Artem Pastukhov, Mykola Driuk, Liliia Kalynovska, Marina Dudarenko, Arsenii Borysov, Valeriy Skryshevsky, Vladimir Lysenko, Tatiana Borisova
In this work, the heavy metal adsorbent was obtained from biowaste using an eco-friendly synthesis protocol with the potential to combat heavy metal poisoning in organisms and wastewater.
